mapLocation.label: Talk to the boy near the gate entrance of Taverley.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Food Store in Port Sarim for 4 gp.
itemsRequired.note: Cheese (You may wish to bring several in case you mess up. One source is in Draynor Village - Aggie's house)

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock for 6 gp.
itemsRequired.note: Leather gloves or any of the gloves listed here (obtainable during the quest, may take some time)

route.title: Entering the house
steps: Talk to the Boy south-east of the long garden in Taverley, next to the members gate. Dialogue: "What's the matter?", "Ok, I'll see what I can do."
Head west, then north to the front door of the house, across from the player-owned house portal.
Look-under the potted plant closest to the door for a door key and enter the door.
Read the Diary on the table
Climb down the ladder to the north, equip gloves, and enter the gate. (The boxes can be searched for a pair of leather gloves.)
Equip your leather gloves before opening the gate.
Search the cupboard for a magnet.
Climb up the ladder and go to the small southern room.
Drop cheese in the room and a mouse will come out.
Use the magnet on the mouse.

route.title: Retrieving the ball
steps: Go around the garden to the fountain without being caught by the Witch. (Full run energy or a stamina potion may be useful.)
Go to the shed on the east and use the key on the door.
Kill the Witch's experiment in all four forms.

route.title: Finishing up
steps: Leave the Witch's house by teleporting out, or by exiting through the garden then the front door.
Go back to the boy and give him the ball.
